premises.text: Cement, steel, and glass need cheap, reliable, flame-hot energy, and today's zero-carbon options cannot deliver all three affordably
premises.evidence_span: Our zero carbon options today are just one out of the three, cheap

premises.text: Joule Hive stores cheap electricity as on-demand heat and pipes hot gas into existing furnaces, boilers, and kilns
premises.evidence_span: We turn it into on-demand heat stored into the system. We make hot gas with that system, blow air through it, make hot air, and deliver it to your furnace, to your boiler, to your kiln

premises.text: The system is retrofittable and delivers up to 1,800 Celsius heat at least three times cheaper than hydrogen
premises.evidence_span: we can keep it affordable, at least three times cheaper than hydrogen. And best of all, we're retrofitable

premises.text: Semiconductor-doped refractory e-bricks enable hotter, longer-lasting electric heating building blocks

premises.text: Stacked bricks simultaneously act as heater, thermal store, and heat exchanger at industrial scale
premises.evidence_span: It's three in one. It's a giant electric heater. It's a giant thermal store. And it's a giant heat exchanger

premises.text: Where electricity is often cheaper than gas, customers can achieve multi-year payback while cutting most emissions
